"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ContextMenu as ContextMenuPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/context-menu" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" /* * Chrome Azure Context Menu — a floating brushed-steel plate. Items light up * with the accent surface on focus; check / radio indicators glow azure so they * read as the same alloy as the rest of the system. */ const ContextMenu = ContextMenuPrimitive.Root const ContextMenuTrigger = ContextMenuPrimitive.Trigger const ContextMenuGroup = ContextMenuPrimitive.Group const ContextMenuPortal = ContextMenuPrimitive.Portal const ContextMenuSub = ContextMenuPrimitive.SubmenuRoot const ContextMenuRadioGroup = ContextMenuPrimitive.RadioGroup // Base UI className can be a state function; the wrappers feed it to cn(), so // narrow it to a plain string (same treatment as the other ported files). type WithClassName

= Omit & { className?: string } const contentStyles = "origin-(--transform-origin) z-50 min-w-[10rem] overflow-hidden p-1 " + "rounded-lg border border-border " + "bg-popover text-popover-foreground " + "[box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)] " + // Radix animate-in/out fade + zoom restated as Base UI starting/ending // style hooks. "transition-[transform,scale,opacity] duration-fast " + "data-starting-style:opacity-0 data-starting-style:scale-95 data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-ending-style:scale-95" const itemStyles = "relative flex cursor-default select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none " + "transition-[background-color,color] duration-fast " + "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground data-[highlighted]:bg-accent data-[highlighted]:text-accent-foreground " + "data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50" const ContextMenuSubTrigger = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName & { inset?: boolean } >(({ className, inset, children, ...props }, ref) => ( {children} )) ContextMenuSubTrigger.displayName = "ContextMenuSubTrigger" const "start", alignOffset = 4, side = "right", sideOffset = 0, ...props }, ref ) => ( ) ) ContextMenuSubContent.displayName = "ContextMenuSubContent" const ContextMenuContent = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) ContextMenuContent.displayName = "ContextMenuContent" const ContextMenuItem = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName & { inset?: boolean } >(({ className, inset, ...props }, ref) => ( )) ContextMenuItem.displayName = "ContextMenuItem" const ContextMenuCheckboxItem = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, children, checked, ...props }, ref) => ( {children} )) ContextMenuCheckboxItem.displayName = "ContextMenuCheckboxItem" const ContextMenuRadioItem = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => ( {children} )) ContextMenuRadioItem.displayName = "ContextMenuRadioItem" const ContextMenuLabel = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName & { inset?: boolean } >(({ className, inset, ...props }, ref) => ( )) ContextMenuLabel.displayName = "ContextMenuLabel" const ContextMenuSeparator = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) ContextMenuSeparator.displayName = "ContextMenuSeparator" const ContextMenuShortcut = ({ className, ...props }: React.HTMLAttributes) => ( ) ContextMenuShortcut.displayName = "ContextMenuShortcut" export { ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuPortal, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuRadioGroup, }
